name: High-Speed Entire Group Search
changes: Entire Group search now scans independent NNTP article-number ranges in bounded parallel worker lanes, respecting the provider browse/download reserve and a global four-lane search cap.
Adaptive request windows (2,500–8,000) use proven 5,000-header fallback when a larger OVER/XOVER request fails, while retrying failures and never silently skipping a claimed range.
Lightweight subject/poster/size prefiltering precedes media and multipart classification, including correct RFC 2047 header decoding.
On-demand live results refresh during scanning without resetting user selection or scroll; display active worker and request counts.
Everything remains ephemeral in process memory; no search index, persistent header cache, or automatic search-history writes.
regression_guards: Actual GroupSearchManager workers exercised against fake NNTP clients for non-overlapping range coverage, bounded fan-out, single-lane providers, retry, failure and prompt cancellation.
Real production overview parser selective fast path compared with unfiltered results, including MIME-encoded subjects, obfuscated names and size filtering.
Search progress and incremental first-page refresh UI behavioral regression.
Retain v3.7.25 Image Sets OFF full-width, v3.7.24 yEnc parser, v3.7.23 unknown-binary discovery, v3.7.22 filename restoration, v3.7.19 disk IO caching and earlier regression gates.
preserved: No persistent search index, search-history database, schema migration or user-data cleanup.
SABnzbd 5.1.2, SABCTools 9.6.3, existing NNTP settings, download manager, service, tray, Automation and Smart Import unchanged.
Metadata Server v0.3.3 and Diagnostic Collector v1.0.31 unchanged.
